design_description: A clean and elegant design inspired by luxury marble textures, featuring a soft off-white base crossed by subtle beige crack patterns across the entire jersey. Royal blue accents on the collar, sleeve cuffs, side panels, and branding create a sharp contrast that gives the kit a modern Mediterranean feel. The marble effect adds sophistication without becoming too busy, keeping the overall composition refined and balanced. Combined with the minimalist sponsor layout, the jersey feels premium, stylish, and lifestyle-oriented rather than overly aggressive.
